verified_behavior: Creation and transfers acquire the same machine locks as lifecycle grants and turn admission; two-machine locks use sorted numeric keys.
Fresh ownership, disk identity, runtime and credential-isolation checks reject stale or foreign attachment and unresolved provider operations.
Uncertain creates cannot gain holders after a stale ready write; confirmed creation identity and retained capacity must still agree.
Updates re-read the parent and rebuild changesets, preserving requested association loading without copying stale associations.
Bulk replacement moves its initiator and current live co-tenants atomically, preserving an individual co-tenant transfer that committed first.
Replacement stages, webhook jobs and local notification jobs commit with the move; outer rollback leaves all bindings and notifications unchanged.
A delayed replacement message cannot stop a newer actor or binding; a matching message closes only the original actor connection.
Autonomous admission requires the actor-original sandbox ID through the actual Connection path; an old actor cannot record a turn on the new machine.
Legacy Team identity reuse requires unanimous locked historical lineage and no provider-operation record; it does not adopt a provider machine by name.
An unresolved managed park returns HTTP409 to an actual public attachment request.
